posts.title: Gentler products, same detail-first clean in Greer
posts.text:
Eco-friendly green cleaning in Greer, SC starts with a simple idea: gentler products should not mean a lighter clean. Our Brazilian team works the same detail-first way in every home, room by room, whether you live near Downtown Greer, off SC-14 or in one of the newer neighborhoods close to GSP Airport.

What changes is the supplies. We use low-odor, family- and pet-friendly products on request, microfiber cloths that capture dust instead of pushing it around, and a hand-wiping technique that uses less product overall. If someone in your house is sensitive to fragrance, ask for the fragrance-free option. Prefer your own brands? Tell us and we will use them.

Families with babies, pet owners and anyone dealing with allergies are the households that ask for this most. Kitchens and bathrooms still get the full checklist, and floors are cleaned with solutions that are safe for the surface.

posts.title: Before your one-time cleaning in Pacolet, SC
posts.text:
Planning a one-time house cleaning in Pacolet, SC? A little preparation helps the team spend their hours on the cleaning instead of on moving things around. Here is what we suggest before your visit.

Pick up loose items from floors, counters and the edges of the bathrooms, so we can reach the baseboards and wipe the surfaces. Put away anything fragile or personal you would rather we not handle. If you want extras such as the inside of the oven, the fridge or the cabinets, say so when you book, since those are add-ons that take extra time.

A one-time clean covers the kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms and living areas, with floors vacuumed and mopped, baseboards and door frames wiped, and mirrors and glass polished. It works well before holidays and family visits, after a party, or ahead of an open house. Many people also use it to try us before setting up regular visits.

Pacolet is a historic mill town in Spartanburg County, and we know how varied the homes can be, from older houses to newer builds. We do a free in-home estimate first and give your exact price after we see the space, with no commitment. Tap Learn more to book your one-time cleaning in Pacolet.

posts.title: A greener cleaning tip for Pickens homes
posts.text:
Here is a simple tip for greener cleaning at home in Pickens, SC: switch from paper towels and sprays to a few good microfiber cloths and use less product than you think you need.

Microfiber grabs dust and lifts grime instead of spreading it, so a lightly dampened cloth often does the job a heavy spray would. On kitchen counters, wipe first with a damp cloth, then go over greasy spots with a small amount of gentle cleaner and wipe again. In bathrooms, let the product sit for a few minutes before you wipe, so it does the work rather than your arm.

That is close to how our team approaches eco-friendly green cleaning. We use low-odor, family- and pet-friendly products on request, hand-wipe surfaces to reduce product use, and offer a fragrance-free option for sensitive households. It is a good fit for families with babies, pet owners and people with allergies, and the checklist stays just as full as a regular clean.

Pickens is the county seat at the foot of the mountains, about 27 miles from our Greer base. Your price comes after a free in-home estimate. Tap Learn more to see green cleaning in Pickens.
